recognize_zh: CSF 中出現成群、體積大且彼此黏合的非造血細胞，核大而圓、染色質粗顆粒、細胞表面佈滿泡狀突起（surface blebs），在乳癌病人要想到軟腦膜轉移癌。
features: Numerous large cells, many in pairs and small cohesive groups
High N:C ratio with enlarged round nuclei and coarsely granular chromatin; nucleoli indistinct at this focus
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm with prominent, uniform peripheral cytoplasmic blebs
Cells markedly larger than the rare red cells in the background
No normal lymphocytes or monocytes in this field
describe_en: CSF cytospin shows numerous large atypical cells arranged singly, in pairs, and in small cohesive groups. The cells have high N:C ratios, enlarged round nuclei with coarsely granular chromatin, and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm with conspicuous peripheral cytoplasmic blebs. Normal lymphocytes and monocytes are not seen in this field. The cohesive growth in a patient with known breast carcinoma favors metastatic carcinoma; with AE1/AE3 positivity and CD45 negativity, findings are consistent with leptomeningeal metastatic carcinoma of mammary origin.

ddx.dx: Leukemic or lymphoma involvement of CSF
ddx.vs: Lymphoma and leukemic blasts are discohesive single cells and CD45 positive, whereas these cells form cohesive groups and are keratin positive, CD45 negative.
Megakaryoblasts can show surface blebs but lack cohesion and express CD41/CD61, not cytokeratin.

ddx.dx: Medulloblastoma or other primary CNS tumor
ddx.vs: Small round blue cell tumors have scant cytoplasm, nuclear molding, and rosettes, and lack epithelial keratin expression in this clinical setting.
Ependymal and choroid plexus cells are bland, uniform, with low N:C ratio and small numbers, unlike these large atypical cells.
